note: SEED LIST -- none of these has been heard on a mat yet. The container this was assembled in cannot reach a radio station, so every address here came from a directory rather than from listening to it. tools/check_stations.py is the thing that settles it: run it on the mat, or on any machine with a speaker and a connection, and it says which of these answer, in what codec, at what bitrate. Anything that does not answer comes out of this file before it is called finished.
licence: The mat is a receiver. Nothing here is copied, stored or passed on -- it opens a station's own public stream the way a radio set does, and the station carries its own music licences. Any station whose terms do not allow another app to open its stream directly comes out of this list; see the note in salaah/radio.py.
